title: Learn Trapping Rain Water, Top K Frequent and Selection Sort with Step-by-Step Visualization in DSA View View 👀👀
why_read: A tutorial-style visualization tool for classic data structures and algorithms problems, useful mainly for learners studying interview-style coding problems.
analysis: This post is part of an ongoing series showcasing a visualization tool called DSA View View that animates algorithm execution for problems like Trapping Rain Water, Top K Frequent Elements, and Selection Sort. It's aimed at people learning or reviewing data structures and algorithms, often for coding interview preparation, rather than presenting novel technical insight. The tool itself sounds like a reasonable teaching aid, but the content is introductory and not aimed at experienced engineers. Modest interest for its target audience of learners rather than a broad professional readership.
